analysis_order: Declared after seeing and retaining the failed linear prototype, before fitting this additional candidate. This is an exploratory conditional-structure comparison, not a previously untouched external validation
conditional_assumption: A multiplicative photosynthetic-damage hypothesis assumes log(Y_U/Y_C) = -sum_j beta_j*(D_Uj-D_Cj), beta_j>=0. This biological interpretation is not verified by these registry means
fit_response: log(Y_C/Y_U); both observed matched grain yields positive
signed_inputs: All measured negative disease reductions and negative yield responses retained; no clipping
asymptotic_bound: For finite linear score, R_hat<1 analytically; floating-point saturation at1 is labelled if it occurs. Negative scores give negative responses
cohort_mutation: None; exact saved memberships and disease inputs from the linear analysis
fit: Origin-constrained nonnegative weighted least squares in log yield-ratio space, signed covariates, equal training trial total weights
baseline: Unchanged: original-scale signed R mean from training trials only, equal total trial weights
evaluation: Same whole-trial folds and equal-trial metrics on original-scale R; one fixed candidate specification, no feature, penalty or hyperparameter selection
temporal_challenge: The 2020-2021 Informer to2022 Pondus predictions are the same stored leave-Pondus-out fold in the52/38 cohorts; not a second independent validation
diagnostics: Identically zero columns, matrix rank, signed differences, sparse co-pathogen signals and response saturation are retained
biological_limits: No measured healthy-area duration, disease-free counterfactual, absolute yield-loss identification or Europe/climate transfer validation is supplied
